messages:
Rina P: Hey team — my calendar shows the "New Hire Orientation" at 17:00 for me but the join link opens a Zoom waiting room and asks for a passcode. The invite body doesn't show a passcode. Anyone know what's up? I'm on AEST so timing is already tricky.
Toby (People Ops): Thanks Rina. We rolled a security update late last night which toggled the passcode on for a subset of recurring meetings. Looks like this event got one of those toggles. Working the fix now.
Devex Bot: Notified: orientation ICS updated. New ICS includes explicit TZ entries and a note: "If prompted for passcode use meeting ID or fallback URL in thread." Updated at 1793548055.
Marcus (IT): Quick workaround if Zoom still prompts: Join -> Meeting ID: 444 5556 777, Passcode: 1992. Some desktop clients cache the old meeting settings; clearing Zoom cache or re-accepting the calendar invite usually fixes it.
Aisha K: I'm in GMT+1 and I saw two entries for the event (one at 09:00 and one at 17:00). I deleted one but worried I deleted the correct one. How can I tell?
Toby (People Ops): Sorry about duplicates — we published a corrected ICS and your calendar may have both the old and new instance. Rule of thumb: keep the event where organizer is "People Ops <peopleops@redwood.com>" and created_at around 1793548000. If unsure, delete both and re-import the ICS from the Devex Bot link.
Rina P: Re-imported ICS, shows 02:00 AEST which is correct for me now. Thanks. Is the session being recorded? I'll need the recording.
Toby (People Ops): Yes. We'll record and upload to Drive -> /Onboarding/2026-Q1-Orientation. We will post the Drive link here after processing and also attach it to the calendar event.
Devex Bot: Drive link placeholder: https://drive.redwood.com/onboarding/2026-q1. Permissions set for @new-hires group.
Marcus (IT): If anyone wants to see local times in the invite: open Google Calendar -> event details -> click "Time zone" -> check "Display secondary time zone" and add your home zone. That helps when you hop between zones.
Aisha K: FYI Zoom mobile sometimes still prompts for passcodes even after desktop fix. Use the fallback URL if mobile asks: https://zoom.us/j/4445556777.
Rina P: Joined fine via fallback URL. Recording link looks good when I tested access. Appreciate the fast responses :pray:
Toby (People Ops): Thanks all. Follow-up: I'll email a short note with the ICS, meeting ID/fallbacks, and a step-by-step to remove duplicate events. Ping me or Marcus if you still see issues.
